title: SpeechRail extension-mode transcription completed event (SPK-E2E-1, version 1)
description: conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed as sent after speechrail.diarization.v1 negotiation: unique item_id, session-sample audio bounds, and NOT the attribution units. The text final is delivered before the slow aligner runs, so it carries status=pending (or not_applicable for an empty transcript) and an empty attribution_units array. Aligned units follow on a separate speechrail.alignment.done event and are then revised in place by speechrail.diarization.updated. Sample ranges are 16 kHz integer sample indexes in the SpeechRail session-global domain; text offsets are codepoint [start,end) ranges into the frozen transcript revision. Alignment units must partition the transcript with no gaps or overlaps (semantic rule; see contracts/realtime-openai.md).

attribution_units.description: Always empty on the text final; the aligned units arrive on speechrail.alignment.done.
